id: title:bernatixer:retry dns failures at custom system one endpoints

review.posthog_relevance: Changes the backend classification and exception raising for DNS failures across System One and OpenRouter endpoints, potentially affecting how connection failures are reported and handled.
review.reason: The chunk contains a substantive implementation change: P1.F2.H1 removes a path-specific check, unifying the exception raised for unresolved hosts across all paths. P1.F3.H1 updates tests to match this behavior. P1.F1.H1 provides documentation. This represents a bounded correctness improvement in the connection handling and error reporting mechanism.
review.uncertainty: The exact downstream impact on customer-facing behavior or recovery workflows is not demonstrated; the change could be an implementation detail or could affect broader error handling, but the code does not show recovery or recovery-dependent behavior.

observations.limitations: This chunk is dominated by documentation and test changes. No implementation or production behavior change is supplied. No score can be assigned.

observations.behavior: Documentation update: adds a sentence about DNS failure behavior for custom System One endpoints.
observations.code_quote: DNS failures at custom System One endpoints also retry without disabling the evaluation or its key.
observations.posthog_connection: Clarifies documented behavior of the AI observability evaluation workflow, but does not demonstrate implementation or test coverage.

observations.behavior: Production implementation: removes the path-specific check for UNRESOLVED_HOST_REASON, treating all unresolved hosts the same.
observations.posthog_connection: Changes the classification of DNS failures: previously, only the 'decisions' path raised ProviderHostUnresolvedError; now, any unresolved host raises it. This could affect how the backend reports and handles connection failures for System One and OpenRouter endpoints.

observations.behavior: Test update: changes the expected exception for the 'systemone' path without an IP from DecisionEndpointBlockedError to ProviderHostUnresolvedError, and adds a test case for an IP address.
observations.posthog_connection: Tests support the implementation change. The test now expects the same exception for unresolved hosts regardless of the path, and also checks that an IP address still results in a blocked error.
